trello.name: Certificate renewal and rotation
trello.desc: Renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy to load balancers by August 22nd for buffer. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public cert) in the same change window. Move both certs onto cert-manager for auto-renewal going forward. Owner: Ben.

trello.name: PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Implement PDF export as one deliverable: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome, frontend adds the export button and a progress state for large reports. Record a short demo GIF for the changelog as part of finishing the feature. Target deadline: end of month. Owner: Aisha.

trello.name: Staging parity
trello.desc: Run the three pending staging migrations to bring staging schema up to production today. Write a nightly job that diffs staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge. Owner: Ben.
